proposed_widenings.name: activated_ability.reaction_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can consume a reaction, but they cannot currently declare the trigger condition that opens that reaction window. This item needs a non-spell reaction trigger gated on a qualifying weapon hit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction

proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary deterministic effect is a one-shot reduction to an incoming damage instance after a hit is confirmed. Existing atoms do not model this; resistance and AC modification are different mechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

notes: No content file was authored. The item's core mechanic requires both a non-spell reaction trigger surface and a damage-reduction effect atom. The catch-on-zero rider is secondary and was not separately classified.
